question_stem: would you do in the following situation?
text: company wants to build a chemical factory in your city. If you allow the company to build the factory, the company will have to pay a lot of money as tax each year to the municipal authorities. This money will help your city pay for essential services such as schools and ambulances, as well as new roads and repairs to current roads. The factory will also bring 500 jobs to your city, which will provide new jobs for current residents and entice new people to move to your city. The company wants special permission to build the factory on a site near a small lake. Many of your city's residents enjoy spending time at the lake. It's a place where families go to have picnics. Several of your residents also enjoy fishing in the lake. Some of the fish that live in the lake are native to your region and do not live anywhere else. What would you recommend? Should the company be allowed to build the factory in your city? Why or why not? Is there a solution that will make everyone happy?
